observations: Three flat-screen TVs are shown, with the front one in focus and two behind it, all standing on tiled floor.
The front TV has a black bezel and a visible LG logo at the bottom center of the screen.
A remote control, a red and white box, and a white box with a TV diagram are placed in front of the TV.
The red box has text 'TV-40"' visible, suggesting a 40-inch model, which contradicts the seller's claim of 32 inches.
The white box shows a diagram of a TV with a stand, possibly a manual or accessory box.
The background includes a yellow generator and cardboard boxes, one labeled 'MADE IN CHINA'.
The screen is off and reflects the surroundings, including the watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ONYEDIKACARDINAL'.
No visible damage to the screen or bezel in the photos.
The TV appears to be a standard LED model, not clearly showing any UHD or 4K indicators on the screen or bezel.
